subject: Marketplace listing: security artifacts delivery plan & split hand-off

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>

Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>

Subject: Marketplace listing: security artifacts delivery plan & split hand-off

Hi Daniel —

Thanks for the walkthrough today. To keep the cloud catalog listing and co-sell packaging on track, here’s the minimal artifact set we need and a suggested split-hand-off so we don’t hold up the marketplace gates: 

Required artifacts (minimal):
- SOC 2 Type II summary and auditor attestation (we can provide a summary PDF publicly; full report via secure NDA link)
- Pen test letter (attestation of most recent engagement; non-sensitive summary)
- DPA (redline for your legal review; final to be executed via DocuSign)
- Evidence inventory spreadsheet mapping artifacts to marketplace checklist items

Proposed delivery split:
- Batch 1 (this week): DPA redline + SOC2 summary + evidence inventory (public-friendly docs)
- Batch 2 (next week): Pen test letter + secure link to SOC2 auditor package (if NDA in place)

Do these dates work for you? If so I’ll loop in Jordan for the marketplace packaging checklist and Sergio for the pen test attestation.

Attachments to follow from our side: schedule workbook (evidence-delivery-schedule.xlsx) and DPA draft.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Director, Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Thanks Camila — this looks good. We can accept a split delivery as long as the DPA is available for legal this week. A few clarifying Qs:

1) Will the full SOC2 report require a separate NDA?
2) Do you have a standard pen-test cover letter (we don't need raw vuln data)?
3) Who is point on the marketplace onboarding checklist?

I attached our internal intake form so your onboarding team has the catalog fields (acme-intake-form.pdf). I can also pull procurement timelines once I hear back on the DPA timeline.

—Daniel
Director, Cloud Partnerships
Acme Corp.

Attachments: acme-intake-form.pdf (application/pdf)

Daniel —

Answers inline: 
1) Full SOC2 report: yes, that requires NDA (standard practice). We’ll provide a secure auditor link for the full package in Batch 2.
2) Pen-test cover letter: we have a one-page attestation we can share publicly; detailed findings remain behind our security team.
3) Marketplace checklist owner: Jordan will own the catalog fields and upload process; I’ll coordinate the evidence mapping.

Proposed firm schedules: 
- This Friday (2026-04-12): DPA redline, SOC2 summary PDF, evidence-delivery-schedule.xlsx (Batch 1)
- Next Wednesday (2026-04-16): Pen test letter + secure auditor link after NDA complete (Batch 2)

Jordan — can you confirm the required catalog metadata fields we need to pre-fill? Sergio — can you attach the SOC2 summary and pen-test cover letter to the thread when available?

HubSpot ref: ACME-1164. I'll start the DocuSign for the DPA once we finalize a few redlines.

Thanks — Camila
